title: Podium Watch
statement:
Scores arrive one at a time: `a_1, a_2, ..., a_n`. After each new score, once at least `k` scores have arrived, look at all scores received so far and find the `k`-th largest one (equal scores count separately).

Print the sum of these `k`-th largest values, over every moment from the `k`-th arrival to the last one.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the sum.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 16000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 10^9`
